literal: In the seventh month of the second year of Jingping, the Young Emperor was deposed.
idiomatic: In the seventh month of the second year of Jingping, the Young Emperor was deposed.

literal: The hundred officials prepared the imperial equipage to welcome him, and he entered to receive the imperial succession.
idiomatic: The officials prepared the imperial equipage to welcome him, and he entered to assume the imperial succession.

literal: When the mobile secretariat reached Jiangling, the imperial seal and ribbon were presented.
idiomatic: When the mobile secretariat reached Jiangling, the imperial seal and ribbon were presented.

literal: Attendant-in-Ordinary Chen Qiu, Regular Attendant-in-Ordinary Chen Yanzhi, Supervisor of the Masters of Writing and Director of the Masters of Writing and General Who Protects the Army and Duke of Jiancheng Fu Liang, General of the Left Guards Yin Jingren, Master of Ceremonies and Colonel of the Rapid Cavalry and Marquis of Longxiang Wang Long, Colonel of the Elite Cavalry and Marquis of Duting Wang Gang, Master of Ceremonies and Gentleman of the Yellow Gate Kong Suanzhi, Gentleman Attendant-at-Large Liu Sixuan, Extraordinary Gentleman Attendant-at-Large Pan Sheng, Gentleman of the Secretariat He Shangzhi, Supervisor of the Feathered Forest and Marquis of Fengyang and Founding Marquis Xiao Sihua, Acting Left Assistant Director of the Masters of Writing and Marquis of Deyang Sun Kang, Director of the Ministry of Personnel and Commandant of Cavalry Zhang Maodu, Director of the Bureau of Rites Xu Changlin, Director of the Bureau of Granaries Yu Junzhi, Director of the Bureau of Justice Yuan Xun, and others submitted a memorial, saying: "Your subjects have heard that adversity and prosperity transform one another, and when the cycle reaches its limit change follows—this is why the Way of Heaven does not grow old, and why the divined span of a dynasty remains numinous and long."
idiomatic: Attendant-in-Ordinary Chen Qiu, Regular Attendant-in-Ordinary Chen Yanzhi, Supervisor of the Masters of Writing and Director of the Masters of Writing and General Who Protects the Army and Duke of Jiancheng Fu Liang, General of the Left Guards Yin Jingren, Master of Ceremonies and Colonel of the Rapid Cavalry and Marquis of Longxiang Wang Long, Colonel of the Elite Cavalry and Marquis of Duting Wang Gang, Master of Ceremonies and Gentleman of the Yellow Gate Kong Suanzhi, Gentleman Attendant-at-Large Liu Sixuan, Extraordinary Gentleman Attendant-at-Large Pan Sheng, Gentleman of the Secretariat He Shangzhi, Supervisor of the Feathered Forest and Founding Marquis of Fengyang Xiao Sihua, Acting Left Assistant Director of the Masters of Writing and Marquis of Deyang Sun Kang, Director of the Ministry of Personnel and Commandant of Cavalry Zhang Maodu, Director of the Bureau of Rites Xu Changlin, Director of the Bureau of Granaries Yu Junzhi, Director of the Bureau of Justice Yuan Xun, and others submitted a memorial, saying: "We have heard that adversity and prosperity transform one another, and when the cycle reaches its limit change follows—this is why the Way of Heaven does not grow old, and why a dynasty's divined span remains numinous and long."

literal: Recently the age has declined, the royal house has been in distress and obscurity, and the commands of the nine domains have had nowhere to go; the enterprise of the High Ancestor was about to fall to the ground.
idiomatic: In recent times the age has declined, the royal house has been in distress, and the commands of the nine domains have had nowhere to turn; the enterprise of the High Ancestor was about to fall to the ground.

literal: Relying on your foundation of deep virtue, men and spirits alike lent their aid, the altars were thereby secured, and the living were brought to order.
idiomatic: Relying on your foundation of deep virtue, men and spirits alike lent their aid, the altars were secured, and the living were brought to order.

literal: We respectfully consider that Your Majesty's sovereign virtue is natural, your sagely clarity holds the throne, filial piety and brotherly duty are manifest in the family and state, and your moral influence is proclaimed in the frontier administrations.
idiomatic: We respectfully consider that Your Majesty's sovereign virtue is innate, your sagely clarity holds the throne, filial piety and brotherly duty are manifest in family and state, and your moral influence is proclaimed in the frontier administrations.

literal: Therefore auspicious omens have come in profusion, and talismanic portents have blazed forth.
idiomatic: Therefore auspicious omens have come in profusion, and talismanic portents have blazed forth.

literal: The spirits of the ancestral temples have turned their gaze westward; the myriad states and all the people look to your radiance and entrust their lives to you.
idiomatic: The spirits of the ancestral temples have turned their gaze westward; the myriad states and all the people look to your radiance and entrust their lives to you.

literal: We, who are unworthy to bear our posts in the court, were privileged to fulfill your commission, and again have gathered in this era of splendid brilliance, again beholding the enterprise of great peace.
idiomatic: We, unworthy though we are to bear our posts at court, were privileged to fulfill your commission and have again gathered in this era of splendid brilliance, again beholding the enterprise of great peace.

literal: The mobile secretariat has arrived; gazing upon the capital walls, we cannot overcome our joy and the feeling of waterfowl on the pond, and respectfully come to the gate to submit this memorial to inform you.
idiomatic: The mobile secretariat has arrived; gazing upon the capital walls, we cannot overcome our joy, and respectfully come to the gate to submit this memorial to inform you.

literal: The Emperor replied: "The imperial fortune has been in hardship and decline, and the cycle has struck repeated adversity; looking up to the lofty foundation, I feel and seek the state's former condition, forever longing for that person, and grief and indignation mingle together.
idiomatic: The Emperor replied: "The imperial fortune has been in hardship and decline, and the cycle has struck repeated adversity; looking up to the lofty foundation, I feel and seek the state's former condition, forever longing for him, and grief and indignation mingle together.

literal: Relying on the enduring fortune of the seven hundred years, and on loyal and worthy assistants in arms and legs, adversity could thereby be turned to prosperity and Heaven and man were set in order.
idiomatic: Relying on the enduring fortune of seven hundred years and on loyal and worthy assistants, adversity could thereby be turned to prosperity and Heaven and man were set in order.

literal: I am contemptibly without virtue and have been mistakenly granted the great mandate; looking back on myself I tremble with fear—how could I bear it?
idiomatic: I am contemptibly without virtue and have been mistakenly granted the great mandate; looking back on myself I tremble with fear—how could I bear it?

literal: I shall for the time being return to the court, display mourning at the imperial tombs, and together with worthy men set forth what is in my heart.
idiomatic: I shall for the time being return to the court, display mourning at the imperial tombs, and together with worthy men set forth what is in my heart.

literal: I hope you will enter into my feelings and do not decline on grounds of ceremony.
idiomatic: I hope you will enter into my feelings and do not decline on grounds of ceremony.

literal: The prefectural and district aides and clerks all styled themselves subjects and requested that placards be inscribed on the various gates, all according to the palace regulations; the Emperor did not permit it.
idiomatic: The prefectural and district aides and clerks all styled themselves subjects and requested that placards be inscribed on the various gates, all according to palace regulations; the Emperor did not permit it.

literal: On the jiaxu day, he set out from Jiangling.
idiomatic: On the jiaxu day, he set out from Jiangling.

literal: On the bingshen day of the eighth month, the imperial carriage reached the capital.
idiomatic: On the bingshen day of the eighth month, the imperial carriage reached the capital.

literal: [1] On the dingyou day, he visited the Chuning Mausoleum, returned to the central hall, and there assumed the imperial throne.
idiomatic: [1] On the dingyou day, he visited the Chuning Mausoleum, returned to the central hall, and there assumed the imperial throne.

literal: On the dingyou day of the eighth month of autumn in the first year of Yuanjia, a general amnesty was proclaimed throughout the realm, and the second year of Jingping was changed to the first year of Yuanjia.
idiomatic: On the dingyou day of the eighth month of autumn in the first year of Yuanjia, a general amnesty was proclaimed, and the second year of Jingping was changed to the first year of Yuanjia.

literal: Civil and military officials were granted two ranks of promotion; overdue rents and old debts were not to be collected again.
idiomatic: Civil and military officials were promoted two ranks; overdue rents and old debts were not to be collected again.

literal: On the gengzi day, Xie Hui, Acting General Who Pacifies the Army and Governor of Jing Province, was made General Who Pacifies the Army and Governor of Jing Province.
idiomatic: On the gengzi day, Xie Hui, Acting General Who Pacifies the Army and Governor of Jing Province, was appointed General Who Pacifies the Army and Governor of Jing Province.

literal: On the guimao day, Xu Xianzhi, Minister of Works and Recorder of Affairs of the Masters of Writing and Governor of Yang Province, was advanced to Minister over the Masses; Wang Hong, General of the Guard and Governor of Jiang Province, was advanced to Minister of Works; Fu Liang, Supervisor of the Masters of Writing and General Who Protects the Army, was given the additional title of Left Grandee of Splendid Virtue with the privilege of a separate office equal to the Three Dukes; Xie Hui, General Who Pacifies the Army and Governor of Jing Province, was advanced in title to General of the Guard; Tan Daoji, General Who Pacifies the North and Governor of Southern Yan Province, was advanced in title to General Who Campaigns against the North.
idiomatic: On the guimao day, Xu Xianzhi, Minister of Works and Recorder of Affairs of the Masters of Writing and Governor of Yang Province, was promoted to Minister over the Masses; Wang Hong, General of the Guard and Governor of Jiang Province, was promoted to Minister of Works; Fu Liang, Supervisor of the Masters of Writing and General Who Protects the Army, was given the additional title of Left Grandee of Splendid Virtue with the privilege of a separate office equal to the Three Dukes; Xie Hui, General Who Pacifies the Army and Governor of Jing Province, was advanced to General of the Guard; Tan Daoji, General Who Pacifies the North and Governor of Southern Yan Province, was advanced to General Who Campaigns against the North.

literal: On the jiachen day, the birth mother, Lady Hu the Brilliant Consort, was posthumously honored as empress dowager with the posthumous title Empress Zhang.
idiomatic: On the jiachen day, his birth mother, Lady Hu the Brilliant Consort, was posthumously honored as empress dowager with the posthumous title Empress Zhang.

literal: Yikang, Prince of Pengcheng, General of Agile Cavalry and Governor of Southern Xu Province, was advanced in title to General of Agile Cavalry; Yigong, General Who Pacifies the Army and Governor of Southern Yu Province, was advanced in title to General Who Pacifies the Army and was enfeoffed as Prince of Jiangxia.
idiomatic: Prince of Pengcheng Yikang, General of Agile Cavalry and Governor of Southern Xu Province, was advanced to General of Agile Cavalry; Yigong, General Who Pacifies the Army and Governor of Southern Yu Province, was advanced to General Who Pacifies the Army and was created Prince of Jiangxia.

literal: The sixth imperial younger brother Yixuan was established as Prince of Jingling, and the seventh imperial younger brother Yiji as Prince of Hengyang.
idiomatic: The sixth imperial younger brother Yixuan was created Prince of Jingling, and the seventh imperial younger brother Yiji as Prince of Hengyang.

literal: On the wushen day, Liu Cui, Governor of Yu Province, was made Governor of Yong Province; Guan Yizhi, General of Valiant Cavalry, was made Governor of Yu Province; and Dao Yanzhi, Colonel of the Southern Man, was made Director of the Central Army.
idiomatic: On the wushen day, Liu Cui, Governor of Yu Province, was appointed Governor of Yong Province; Guan Yizhi, General of Valiant Cavalry, was appointed Governor of Yu Province; and Dao Yanzhi, Colonel of the Southern Man, was appointed Director of the Central Army.

literal: On the jiyou day, this year's tax cloth in Jing and Xiang provinces was reduced by half.
idiomatic: On the jiyou day, this year's tax cloth in Jing and Xiang provinces was reduced by half.

literal: On the bingzi day of the ninth month, Consort Yuan was established as empress.
idiomatic: On the bingzi day of the ninth month, Consort Yuan was established as empress.

literal: In the first month of spring of the second year, on the bingyin day, Xu Xianzhi, Minister over the Masses, and Fu Liang, Director of the Masters of Writing, submitted a memorial returning government to the throne; the Emperor for the first time personally reviewed affairs.
idiomatic: In the first month of spring of the second year, on the bingyin day, Minister over the Masses Xu Xianzhi and Director of the Masters of Writing Fu Liang submitted a memorial returning government to the throne; the Emperor for the first time personally reviewed affairs.

literal: On the xinwei day, the imperial carriage sacrificed at the southern suburb; [2] a general amnesty was proclaimed.
idiomatic: On the xinwei day, the Emperor sacrificed at the southern suburb; [2] a general amnesty was proclaimed.

literal: On the yichou day of the third month, Wang Zhongde, General of the Left and Governor of Xu Province, was advanced in title to General Who Pacifies the North.
idiomatic: On the yichou day of the third month, Wang Zhongde, General of the Left and Governor of Xu Province, was advanced to General Who Pacifies the North.

literal: On the wuyin day of the fifth month in summer, Xie Dan, Special Grandee, died.
idiomatic: On the wuyin day of the fifth month in summer, Special Grandee Xie Dan died.

literal: On the jiashen day of the eighth month in autumn, because refugees from the Guanzhong region had come out to the Han River valley, the commanderies of Jingzhao, Fufeng, and Fengyi were established.
idiomatic: On the jiashen day of the eighth month in autumn, because refugees from the Guanzhong region had come out to the Han River valley, the commanderies of Jingzhao, Fufeng, and Fengyi were established.

literal: On the yiyou day, Yikang, Prince of Pengcheng, General of Agile Cavalry and Governor of Southern Xu Province, was given the privilege of a separate office equal to the Three Dukes; Wang Hong, newly appointed Minister of Works, was made General of Chariots and Cavalry and Grand General with the privilege of a separate office equal to the Three Dukes; Jiang Heng, Senior Clerk of the Right Army, was made Governor of Guang Province.
idiomatic: On the yiyou day, Prince of Pengcheng Yikang, General of Agile Cavalry and Governor of Southern Xu Province, was given the privilege of a separate office equal to the Three Dukes; newly appointed Minister of Works Wang Hong was made General of Chariots and Cavalry and Grand General with the privilege of a separate office equal to the Three Dukes; Jiang Heng, Senior Clerk of the Right Army, was appointed Governor of Guang Province.

literal: On the guiyou day of the eleventh month in winter, Yang Xuan, former General of the Van, was made General Who Campaigns West and Governor of Northern Qin Province.
idiomatic: On the guiyou day of the eleventh month in winter, Yang Xuan, former General of the Van, was appointed General Who Campaigns West and Governor of Northern Qin Province.

literal: In the first month of spring of the third year, on the bingyin day, Xu Xianzhi, Minister over the Masses and Recorder of Affairs of the Masters of Writing and Governor of Yang Province, Fu Liang, Director of the Masters of Writing and General Who Protects the Army and Left Grandee of Splendid Virtue, were guilty and executed.
idiomatic: In the first month of spring of the third year, on the bingyin day, Xu Xianzhi, Minister over the Masses and Recorder of Affairs of the Masters of Writing and Governor of Yang Province, and Fu Liang, Director of the Masters of Writing and General Who Protects the Army and Left Grandee of Splendid Virtue, were found guilty and executed.

literal: The Director of the Central Army Dao Yanzhi and the General Who Campaigns against the North Tan Daoji were dispatched to campaign against Xie Hui, Governor of Jing Province; the Emperor personally led the six armies on a western expedition.
idiomatic: The Director of the Central Army Dao Yanzhi and General Who Campaigns against the North Tan Daoji were dispatched to campaign against Xie Hui, Governor of Jing Province; the Emperor personally led the six armies on a western expedition.

literal: A general amnesty was proclaimed.
idiomatic: A general amnesty was proclaimed.

literal: On the dingmao day, Wang Hong, General of Chariots and Cavalry and Governor of Jiang Province, was made Minister over the Masses, Recorder of Affairs of the Masters of Writing, and Governor of Yang Province; Yikang, Prince of Pengcheng, General of Agile Cavalry and Governor of Southern Xu Province, was changed to Governor of Jing Province; Yigong, Prince of Jiangxia, General Who Pacifies the Army and Governor of Southern Yu Province, was changed to Governor of Southern Xu Province.
idiomatic: On the dingmao day, Wang Hong, General of Chariots and Cavalry and Governor of Jiang Province, was appointed Minister over the Masses, Recorder of Affairs of the Masters of Writing, and Governor of Yang Province; Prince of Pengcheng Yikang, General of Agile Cavalry and Governor of Southern Xu Province, became Governor of Jing Province; Prince of Jiangxia Yigong, General Who Pacifies the Army and Governor of Southern Yu Province, became Governor of Southern Xu Province.

literal: On the jisi day, Zhao Lunzhi, former General Who Protects the Army, was made General Who Leads the Army.
idiomatic: On the jisi day, Zhao Lunzhi, former General Who Protects the Army, was appointed General Who Leads the Army.

literal: On the bingxu day of the intercalary month, the imperial son Shao was born.
idiomatic: On the bingxu day of the intercalary month, the imperial son Shao was born.

literal: On the yimao day of the second month, all prisoners awaiting judgment and convicts in exile were entirely pardoned.
idiomatic: On the yimao day of the second month, all prisoners awaiting judgment and convicts in exile were entirely pardoned.

literal: On the wuwu day, Wang Jinghong, Grandee of the Golden Chariot and Purple Canopy, was made Left Vice Director of the Masters of Writing; Zheng Xianzhi, Administrator of Zhang Commandery, was made Right Vice Director of the Masters of Writing.
idiomatic: On the wuwu day, Wang Jinghong, Grandee of the Golden Chariot and Purple Canopy, was appointed Left Vice Director of the Masters of Writing; Zheng Xianzhi, Administrator of Zhang Commandery, was appointed Right Vice Director of the Masters of Writing.

literal: Pan Sheng, Administrator of Jian'an, was guilty and executed.
idiomatic: Pan Sheng, Administrator of Jian'an, was found guilty and executed.

literal: [3] On the gengshen day, Fan Tai, Special Grandee, was given the additional title of Grandee of Splendid Virtue.
idiomatic: [3] On the gengshen day, Special Grandee Fan Tai was given the additional title of Grandee of Splendid Virtue.

literal: That day, the imperial carriage set out from the capital.
idiomatic: That day, the imperial carriage set out from the capital.

literal: On the wuchen day, Dao Yanzhi and Tan Daoji inflicted a great defeat on Xie Hui at Yinji.
idiomatic: On the wuchen day, Dao Yanzhi and Tan Daoji inflicted a great defeat on Xie Hui at Yinji.

literal: On the bingzi day, the imperial carriage turned its banners back from Wuhu.
idiomatic: On the bingzi day, the imperial carriage turned back from Wuhu.

literal: On the jimao day, Hui was captured at Yantou and sent to the capital, where he was executed.
idiomatic: On the jimao day, Hui was captured at Yantou and sent to the capital, where he was executed.

literal: On the xinsi day of the third month, the imperial carriage returned to the palace.
idiomatic: On the xinsi day of the third month, the imperial carriage returned to the palace.

literal: On the yiwei day of the fifth month in summer, Tan Daoji, General Who Campaigns against the North and Governor of Southern Yan Province, was made General Who Campaigns South and Governor of Jiang Province; Dao Yanzhi, Director of the Central Army, was made Governor of Southern Yu Province.
idiomatic: On the yiwei day of the fifth month in summer, Tan Daoji, General Who Campaigns against the North and Governor of Southern Yan Province, was appointed General Who Campaigns South and Governor of Jiang Province; Dao Yanzhi, Director of the Central Army, was appointed Governor of Southern Yu Province.

literal: On the wuxu day, Yixin, Prince of Changsha and General of the Rear, was made Governor of Southern Yan Province.
idiomatic: On the wuxu day, Prince of Changsha Yixin, General of the Rear, was appointed Governor of Southern Yan Province.

literal: On the yisi day, Juqu Mengxun, Prince of Northern Liang and Governor of Liang Province, was changed in title to General of Chariots and Cavalry.
idiomatic: On the yisi day, Juqu Mengxun, Prince of Northern Liang and Governor of Liang Province, was redesignated General of Chariots and Cavalry.

literal: An edict said: "When a sage king governs the age, he broadly extends the four kinds of hearing, yet still tours the mountains and inspects the regions, gathering wind and observing government.
idiomatic: An edict said: "When a sage king governs the age, he broadly extends the four kinds of hearing, yet still tours the mountains and inspects the regions, gathering wind and observing government.

literal: By this means truth and falsehood are surely examined, the remote and secluded are not blocked, royal favor is not obstructed, and the nine marshes have those who hear.
idiomatic: By this means truth and falsehood are surely examined, the remote and secluded are not blocked, royal favor is not obstructed, and the nine marshes have those who hear.

literal: I, being few and thin, have contemptibly succeeded to the great succession.
idiomatic: I, being few and thin, have contemptibly succeeded to the great succession.

literal: Although I forever bear the way of governance in mind and my purpose rests in the time before dawn, and though I would speak of Fu Yue's cliff and rise in thought at midnight, yet the excellence of hill and garden, talents still unrevealed, the feelings of the people and what is hidden from view, still stand apart from sight and hearing.
idiomatic: Although I forever bear the way of governance in mind and my purpose rests before dawn, and though I would speak of Fu Yue's cliff and rise in thought at midnight, yet the excellence of hill and garden, talents still unrevealed, the feelings of the people and what is hidden from view, still stand apart from sight and hearing.

literal: Therefore I turn my regard to the regions and cease sleep and forget meals.
idiomatic: Therefore I turn my regard to the regions and cease sleep and forget meals.

literal: Now the baleful vapors have been swept away and the realm within the four seas is tranquil; to raise the worthy and extend transformation begins from this.
idiomatic: Now the baleful vapors have been swept away and the realm within the four seas is tranquil; to raise the worthy and extend transformation begins from this.

literal: Grand envoys may be dispatched to tour the four quarters.
idiomatic: Grand envoys may be dispatched to tour the four quarters.

literal: Those prefects and magistrates who are worthy in office, and good men of humble gate or single recommendation, are to be reported in full detail in memorials, and nothing is to be omitted.
idiomatic: Those prefects and magistrates who are worthy in office, and good men of humble gate or single recommendation, are to be reported in full detail in memorials, and nothing is to be omitted.

literal: If in criminal cases there is no compassion, or in government there is deviation and error, or if the people are harmed and teaching injured, report the matter in full.
idiomatic: If in criminal cases there is no compassion, or in government there is deviation and error, or if the people are harmed and teaching injured, report the matter in full.

literal: The elderly, widowers and widows, orphans and the young, and those afflicted with the six infirmities who cannot support themselves may be generously relieved and provided for together with the commanderies and counties.
idiomatic: The elderly, widowers and widows, orphans and the young, and those afflicted with the six infirmities who cannot support themselves may be generously relieved and provided for together with the commanderies and counties.

literal: Broadly gather popular reports, widely receive excellent counsel, and strive to exhaust the intent of your commission, as if I were personally reviewing it.
idiomatic: Broadly gather popular reports, widely receive excellent counsel, and strive to exhaust the intent of your commission, as if I were personally reviewing it.

literal: On the bingwu day, the imperial carriage attended at the Hall of Extended Worthies to hear cases.
idiomatic: On the bingwu day, the Emperor attended at the Hall of Extended Worthies to hear cases.

literal: On the jiwei day of the sixth month, Zhao Lunzhi, General Who Leads the Army, was made Left Grandee of Splendid Virtue and Director of the Army.
idiomatic: On the jiwei day of the sixth month, Zhao Lunzhi, General Who Leads the Army, was appointed Left Grandee of Splendid Virtue and Director of the Army.

literal: On the bingyin day, the imperial carriage again attended at the Hall of Extended Worthies to hear cases.
idiomatic: On the bingyin day, the Emperor again attended at the Hall of Extended Worthies to hear cases.

literal: On the bingzi day, he again heard cases.
idiomatic: On the bingzi day, he again heard cases.

literal: Wang Hua of the Right Guards was made Director of the Army for the Heir Apparent.
idiomatic: Wang Hua of the Right Guards was appointed Director of the Army for the Heir Apparent.

literal: On the wuyin day of the eleventh month in winter, Ji Han, Governor of Liang and Southern Qin provinces, was made Governor of Yi Province; Liu Daochan, Staff Officer of the General of Agile Cavalry, was made Governor of Liang and Southern Qin provinces.
idiomatic: On the wuyin day of the eleventh month in winter, Ji Han, Governor of Liang and Southern Qin provinces, was appointed Governor of Yi Province; Liu Daochan, Staff Officer of the General of Agile Cavalry, was appointed Governor of Liang and Southern Qin provinces.

literal: On the jihai day, Liu Zunkao, Colonel of the Southern Man, was made Governor of Yong Province.
idiomatic: On the jihai day, Liu Zunkao, Colonel of the Southern Man, was appointed Governor of Yong Province.

literal: On the guichou day of the twelfth month, Xiao Sihua, Gentleman of the Secretariat, was made Governor of Qing Province.
idiomatic: On the guichou day of the twelfth month, Xiao Sihua, Gentleman of the Secretariat, was appointed Governor of Qing Province.

literal: On the renxu day, Xu Peizhi, former Administrator of Wu Commandery, plotted rebellion; he and his accomplices were all executed.
idiomatic: On the renxu day, Xu Peizhi, former Administrator of Wu Commandery, plotted rebellion; he and his accomplices were all executed.

literal: On the first day of the first month of spring of the fourth year, the day yihai, a partial amnesty was proclaimed within a hundred li of the capital.
idiomatic: On the first day of the first month of spring of the fourth year, yihai, a partial amnesty was proclaimed within a hundred li of the capital.

literal: On the xinsi day, the imperial carriage personally sacrificed at the southern suburb.
idiomatic: On the xinsi day, the Emperor personally sacrificed at the southern suburb.

literal: On the yimao day of the second month, he traveled to Dantu and visited the Jing Mausoleum.
idiomatic: On the yimao day of the second month, he traveled to Dantu and visited the Jing Mausoleum.

literal: On the bingzi day of the third month, an edict said: "Dantu is intimately bound to the silkworm and mulberry of our native place; the great enterprise began there; treading that territory awakens everlasting feeling, and touching it moves me beyond measure.
idiomatic: On the bingzi day of the third month, an edict said: "Dantu is intimately bound to the silkworm and mulberry of our native place; the great enterprise began there; treading that territory awakens everlasting feeling, and touching it moves me beyond measure.

literal: Formerly when Emperor Zhang of Han made his southern tour he added favor to Yuan clan; how much more when affection and righteousness are doubled and redoubled, surpassing those former days.
idiomatic: Formerly when Emperor Zhang of Han made his southern tour he added favor to the Yuan clan; how much more when affection and righteousness are doubled and redoubled, surpassing those former days.

literal: I think to spread the lingering beneficence and repay and comfort the gentry and people.
idiomatic: I think to spread the lingering beneficence and repay and comfort the gentry and people.

literal: Let this county be exempted from this year's rent and cloth; all punishments of five years or less are entirely remitted;
idiomatic: Let this county be exempted from this year's rent and cloth; all punishments of five years or less are entirely remitted;

literal: those who fought three battles in storming the city and the households of great generals are to receive condolence and relief as appropriate.
idiomatic: those who fought three battles in storming the city and the households of great generals are to receive condolence and relief as appropriate.

literal: On the dinghai day, the imperial carriage returned to the palace.
idiomatic: On the dinghai day, the imperial carriage returned to the palace.

literal: On the wuzi day, Zheng Xianzhi, Right Vice Director of the Masters of Writing, died.
idiomatic: On the wuzi day, Zheng Xianzhi, Right Vice Director of the Masters of Writing, died.

literal: On the renyin day, the use on the summer solstice of five-colored silk life-cords and the like was forbidden—this was the proposal of Zhuge Qianzhi, Magistrate of Fuyang.
idiomatic: On the renyin day, the use on the summer solstice of five-colored silk life-cords and the like was forbidden—this was the proposal of Zhuge Qianzhi, Magistrate of Fuyang.

literal: On the gengxu day of the fourth month in summer, Wang Huizhi, Commandant of Punishments, was made Governor of Jiao Province.
idiomatic: On the gengxu day of the fourth month in summer, Wang Huizhi, Commandant of Punishments, was appointed Governor of Jiao Province.

literal: On the renwu day of the fifth month, Wang Hua, Director of the Army for the Heir Apparent, died.
idiomatic: On the renwu day of the fifth month, Wang Hua, Director of the Army for the Heir Apparent, died.

literal: An epidemic struck the capital; on the jiawu day, envoys were sent to inquire after the people and provide medicine;
idiomatic: An epidemic struck the capital; on the jiawu day, envoys were sent to inquire after the people and provide medicine;

literal: those who died and had no family were given coffins.
idiomatic: those who died and had no family were given coffins.

literal: On the first day of the sixth month, the day guimao, there was an eclipse of the sun.
idiomatic: On the first day of the sixth month, guimao, there was a solar eclipse.

literal: On the gengshen day, Yin Mu, Grandee of the Golden Chariot and Purple Canopy, was made General Who Protects the Army.
idiomatic: On the gengshen day, Yin Mu, Grandee of the Golden Chariot and Purple Canopy, was appointed General Who Protects the Army.

literal: On the yihai day of the first month of spring of the fifth year, an edict said: "I respectfully receive the great enterprise and preside over feasting on the four seas; custom and transformation are not yet broadly spread, and the way of governance has many obscurities; seeking it in human affairs, in waking and sleeping alike I have only worry.
idiomatic: On the yihai day of the first month of spring of the fifth year, an edict said: "I respectfully receive the great enterprise and preside over the four seas; custom and transformation are not yet broadly spread, and the way of governance has many obscurities; seeking it in human affairs, in waking and sleeping alike I have only worry.

literal: Moreover, in recent times yin and yang have violated their sequence, drought and pestilence have become calamities; looking up to the disaster warnings, the blame lies deep in me.
idiomatic: Moreover, in recent times yin and yang have violated their sequence, drought and pestilence have become calamities; looking up to the disaster warnings, the blame lies deep in me.

literal: I think how to turn my person and restrain my thoughts, deliberate on cases and examine punishments in detail, above to answer Heaven's reproof, below to comfort the people's afflictions.
idiomatic: I think how to turn my person and restrain my thoughts, deliberate on cases and examine punishments in detail, above to answer Heaven's reproof, below to comfort the people's afflictions.

literal: The hundred officials at all ranks are each to present loyal words, pointing out gains and losses, and are not to hold anything back.
idiomatic: The hundred officials at all ranks are each to present loyal words, pointing out gains and losses, and are not to hold anything back.

literal: On the jiashen day, the imperial carriage attended at the Black Tortoise Hall to review martial exercises.
idiomatic: On the jiashen day, the Emperor attended at the Black Tortoise Hall to review martial exercises.

literal: On the wuzi day, a great fire broke out in the capital; envoys were sent to tour and comfort and grant relief.
idiomatic: On the wuzi day, a great fire broke out in the capital; envoys were sent to tour and comfort and grant relief.

literal: On the jihai day of the fourth month in summer, Xiao Muzhi, Colonel of the Southern Man, was made Governor of Xiang Province.
idiomatic: On the jihai day of the fourth month in summer, Xiao Muzhi, Colonel of the Southern Man, was appointed Governor of Xiang Province.

literal: On the wuwu day, Xu Huo, Administrator of Shixing, was made Governor of Guang Province.
idiomatic: On the wuwu day, Xu Huo, Administrator of Shixing, was appointed Governor of Guang Province.
